page_title: LYO 3-0 MET | Lyon v Metz 23/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Eric Wattellier is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Lyon take a short corner kick.
90+6' Adam Karabec (Lyon) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Lyon win a corner kick.
90+5' The ball has crossed the sideline. Lyon are taking a throw-in.
90+3' Lyon control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
90+2' The corner is swung in but Metz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+1' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' Great teamplay by Lyon as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
86' Here is a change. Malick Fofana is going off and Jorge Maciel gives the last tactical orders to Afonso Moreira (Lyon).
86' We are about to witness a substitution. Ruben Kluivert (Lyon) is replacing Clinton Mata.
85' Morgan Bokele Mputu (Metz) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Remy Descamps comes off the line to clear the ball away.
83' 3 - 0 Goal! Adam Karabec (Lyon) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 3:0.
82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Koffi Kouao (Metz) was quite harsh and Eric Wattellier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
81' Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. A free kick is awarded to Metz.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Brian Madjo departs the field of play to be replaced by Idrissa Gueye (Metz).
80' Lyon move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession.
78' Referee Eric Wattellier sees the trip by Sadibou Sane (Metz) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
78' Great teamplay by Lyon as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
76' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header low towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
75' It will be a substitution. Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) is ready to enter the pitch as Abner Vinicius walks off.
74' Jorge Maciel has decided to substitute Corentin Tolisso and he is replaced by Khalis Merah (Lyon).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pavel Sulc trots off the pitch and is replaced by Adam Karabec (Lyon).

72' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort.
72' Tyler Morton (Lyon) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Jonathan Fischer sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post.
71' Neat passing move from Lyon in order to create new attacking opportunities.

69' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
69' Lyon are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
67' Lyon show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
66' Lyon seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
62' Stephane Le Mignan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Morgan Bokele Mputu (Metz) replacing Giorgi Abuashvili.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ibou Sane (Metz) is coming onto the pitch as Georgiy Tsitaishvili cannot continue after picking up an injury.
62' Metz work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

62' Koffi Kouao (Metz) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag and Metz will take a corner.
60' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Koffi Kouao (Metz) heads on.
60' Metz control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
59' Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
58' The resulting corner from Tyler Morton (Lyon) is cleared.
55' The referee blows for a cooling break.
54' Boubacar Traore (Metz) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
52' Some neat passing and movement from Metz as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
51' Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.

50' Lyon slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
48' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent. Lyon are awarded the free kick.
47' Sadibou Sane (Metz) makes a strong challenge and Eric Wattellier blows for a foul. Free kick. Lyon will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
46' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
45+1' Benjamin Stambouli (Metz) commits a rough foul. Eric Wattellier stops the game and makes a call. It's a free kick to Lyon, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' A free kick has been awarded to Metz.
42' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Metz.
41' We are about to witness a subsitution. Alpha Toure (Metz) for Urie-Michel Mboula.
40' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
39' Metz quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
37' Great teamplay by Lyon as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
36' Lyon are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession.
34' Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

30' 2 - 0 Goal! Ainsley Maitland-Niles displays great vision and sends a pass to Corentin Tolisso (Lyon), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 2:0.
28' Lyon enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
25' 1 - 0 Pavel Sulc feeds the ball through to Malick Fofana (Lyon), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:0!
22' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul. Metz have been awarded a free kick.
21' The Lyon players are exchanging some short passes.
19' Brian Madjo (Metz) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
18' The ball is out of play. Metz will take a throw-in.
17' The Lyon players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
13' Boubacar Traore (Metz) picks up a short pass and immediately fires a shot towards the middle of the goal from distance, but Remy Descamps hardly has to move and makes a very easy save.
12' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) makes a rough challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Metz, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
11' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
10' Eric Wattellier interrupts the game. One of the players from Lyon won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
9' Lyon concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player. Metz have a free kick.

8' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) misses a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball floats high over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
7' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
6' Tyler Morton (Lyon) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

5' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Jonathan Fischer has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. Lyon force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
4' Brian Madjo (Metz) is penalised for a foul. Eric Wattellier had a clear view and blows his whistle.
4' Urie-Michel Mboula (Metz) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
3' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
3' The Lyon players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Lyon will kick-off.
Eric Wattellier will officiate today.
